name: Recycling
description: The software project will develop a user-friendly web application that allows users to discover and manage recycling facilities. Key features include searching for nearby centers by zip code, viewing operational hours, accessing maps of recycling locations, and receiving notifications about events. Administrators will manage facility information and user feedback, ensuring data security while enabling communication between facility representatives and site admins to improve community recycling efforts.
rawDescription: The software project will develop a user-friendly web application that allows users to discover and manage recycling facilities. Key features include searching for nearby centers by zip code, viewing operational hours, accessing maps of recycling locations, and receiving notifications about events. Administrators will manage facility information and user feedback, ensuring data security while enabling communication between facility representatives and site admins to improve community recycling efforts.
highLevelGoals: Users aim to quickly find recycling centers that meet their needs, including location, operational hours, and accessibility.
Users want to receive timely notifications regarding recycling events, changes in facility information, or other relevant community updates.
Administrators seek to ensure that all facility details, such as operational hours and locations, are current and correct within the system.
Administrators aim to process and respond to user feedback to enhance the overall quality and usability of the recycling facility discovery platform.
Administrators are responsible for safeguarding all data within the application, including facility details and user information, from unauthorized access or corruption.
Facility Representatives aim to submit and update their facility's details to ensure users have access to correct and current information.
Facility Representatives seek to effectively communicate with site administrators to clarify or verify facility information, ensuring it is accurately displayed to users.
lowLevelGoals: The User can invoke an API to search for recycling facilities within a specified radius of a given latitude and longitude.
The User can invoke an API to search for recycling facilities within a specified zip code area.
The User can invoke an API to filter the list of recycling facilities based on the types of materials they accept (e.g., plastic, paper, glass).
The User can invoke an API to fetch comprehensive details for a selected recycling facility, including operational hours, address, and contact information.
The User can invoke an API to fetch geographical coordinates (latitude and longitude) for a specific recycling facility to display on a map.
The User can invoke an API to generate navigation directions from their current location to a chosen recycling facility.
The User can invoke an API to subscribe to receive alerts when information (e.g., hours, services) for a particular recycling facility changes.
The User can invoke an API to subscribe to receive alerts about upcoming recycling events or community initiatives.
The User can invoke an API to fetch a list of all notifications that have not yet been marked as read.
The User can invoke an API to change the status of a particular notification to 'read'.
The User can invoke an API to submit feedback, suggestions, or report issues regarding the application or facility information.
The Administrator can invoke an API to add a new recycling facility with its details (e.g., name, address, hours, materials accepted) to the database.
The Administrator can invoke an API to modify specific attributes (e.g., operational hours, contact info) of an already existing recycling facility record.
The Administrator can invoke an API to review and officially accept a submitted update to a facility's information, making it live in the system.
The Administrator can invoke an API to mark a recycling facility as inactive, removing it from public view without permanently deleting its data.
The Administrator can invoke an API to fetch a comprehensive list of all feedback entries submitted by users.
The Administrator can invoke an API to update the status of a specific user feedback entry to indicate it has been addressed or reviewed.
The Administrator can invoke an API to compose and send a reply to a specific user feedback submission.
The Administrator can invoke an API to modify the access level and capabilities of a specific user within the system.
The Administrator can invoke an API to fetch records of user logins, data modifications, and other system interactions for security auditing.
The Administrator can invoke an API to immediately terminate a specific user's ability to log in or interact with the application.
The Facility Representative can invoke an API to submit comprehensive details for a new recycling facility to be added to the system, pending administrator approval.
The Facility Representative can invoke an API to propose changes to the details (e.g., hours, materials) of a facility they represent, for administrator review.
The Facility Representative can invoke an API to check whether their previously submitted facility information or updates have been approved, rejected, or are still pending.
The Facility Representative can invoke an API to send a direct message to an administrator to clarify or discuss details about their facility.
The Facility Representative can invoke an API to view any communications or requests for clarification sent by administrators concerning their facility's information.

baselineCritiques.actors: The identified actors are accurate and well-aligned with the software description. "User" covers the primary end-users who search and manage facilities. "Administrator" correctly identifies the role responsible for managing data and security. "Facility Representative" is a valid actor as the description explicitly mentions communication between facility representatives and site admins. No significant omissions or contradictions were found.
baselineCritiques.highLevelGoals: The provided high-level goals are well-aligned with the software description and actors. They correctly capture the functional needs of the User (discovery, notifications), Administrator (data management, feedback, security), and Facility Representative (information provision, collaboration). There are no contradictions, and no major functional omissions are evident. The goals are appropriately abstract (high-level) and focus on the 'why' and 'what' rather than technical implementation details.
baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals are well-structured, functional, and correctly mapped to the high-level goals and actors. They cover the core functionalities for Users (search, view, notify), Administrators (manage facilities, feedback, security), and Facility Representatives (submit updates, communicate). However, there is a minor omission regarding the "accessing maps" feature mentioned in the description and high-level goals. While there is a goal to "Retrieve map coordinates," there is no explicit goal for the User to "View the map interface" or "Display facilities on a map," which is a distinct user action from just fetching data. Additionally, the description mentions "managing" recycling facilities for users, which is ambiguous; if it implies saving favorites or a personal list, that functionality is missing. Assuming "manage" was a loose term for "interact with," the omission of the map display action is the primary gap.
